Metadata.Title: Pro Bank Robbery
Metadata.Description: 假药集团旗下洗钱银行，该机构长期为团伙存放非法所得赃款。今日，47将亲临现场，办理一笔“大额取款”——全额提取，不留分毫，并额外附赠银行管理层“永久销户”服务。所有交易均免手续费，且无需后续对账。The money-laundering bank owned by the fake drug ring. Today, 47 walks in for a "large withdrawal" – all of it – and offers the management a "permanent account closure." No fees, no paperwork.
